integrity: The published squarefree-and-disjoint-support reduction was checked in the full Ufnarovski--Ahlander article. The new step uses both cycle equations to obtain reciprocal sums A and B with AB=1, hence A+B>=2. An exact rational certificate shows that any 58 distinct primes have reciprocal sum below 2. The packaged verifier reconstructs the prime list and rational comparison independently.
scientific_limitations: The theorem gives a necessary support bound for a hypothetical nontrivial positive two-cycle of the ordinary arithmetic derivative; it does not establish existence or nonexistence of such cycles. The constant 59 is the limit of the combined reciprocal-sum obstruction because the sum of reciprocals of the first 59 primes already exceeds 2.
title: A 59-prime support barrier for arithmetic-derivative two-cycles
